tasks.title: Propose greenfield ceiling + benchmark alongside smallest slice
tasks.prompt: Webhook deliveries fail intermittently and callers keep adding ad-hoc retry loops. Propose a one-page shape before code.
tasks.reference_response:
Goal: Reliable webhook delivery without ad-hoc caller retries.
Greenfield ceiling: Single idempotent outbox + typed delivery state machine (queued -> sending -> delivered | dead_letter) with one backoff worker.
Benchmark: 99.9% delivery within 60s and 0 duplicate side effects across 1,000 fault-injected replays.
Smallest version: Centralize retries into one helper with an idempotency key header, then migrate callers.
